Name: Prophet's Dining Room
Author: TheDeafProphet
Description:
[size=3]After finishing[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26988] my kitchen mod[/url], I set about to decorating the dining room in my farmhouse. During this endeavour, I thought to myself, wouldn't it be nice to have a matching dining room? And here were are!

You can see most of the furniture in the images provided - and I even made some colour variations you can access using alternative textures! Bit of a learning curve here or there but i'm quite happy with how it turned out. You can even use alternative textures to make longer benches!


[b]How to use mod: [/b]Install the files here (both the CP and the AT version) and then make sure you also have content patcher or alternative textures installed! (And smapi, of course) 
[/size]
[size=3][b]How To Acquire Items: [/b]Either use an item spawner like CJB's orrrrrrrr you can download[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27897] the furniture catalogue[/url] I made just for this purpose! 

[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28177]Update: Matching rug mod released! Check it out if you want :3 [/url]

[size=3][url=https://bsky.app/profile/prophetmods.bsky.social]Come say hi on bluesky[/url] if you wanna see what I'm up to in the meantime! I'm a bit more responsive there

[/size]and if you would like to support me...
[url=https://ko-fi.com/prophetmods]I recently made a ko-fi ! All the cool kids are doing it[/url]

My usual disclaimer that I am an artist and not a top-tier programmer, so while its working on my end, if theres a unique issue on your side I don't know if I can help~
